craft_notes: Sthāyin: double-ask (lift and soothe). Rows: row 2 (favor→glances). Close: glances (kaṭākṣa as landing: cool glances close the heat). Rejected: 'save me' merged — kept two asks distinct (lift AND soothe); 'mother' softener — kept lady (parameśvari as address kept formal).

lines: Lady of five sports, knowing-formed supreme, Pārvatī — favor:
raise the fallen snare-bound one; lull the child with cool glances.
l4.sanskrit_cite: parameśvari pañcakṛtyalīle parasaṃvinmayi pārvati prasīda | patitaṃ paśupāśamuddharemaṃ śiśumāśvāsaya śītalaiḥ kaṭākṣeḥ

reads_against.argmap: What is asked of the five-act lady? → Double petition: lift the fallen fettered one; soothe the child — cool glances for heat.
